dataset.name: T-REx — Real-World Knowledge
dataset.description: Evaluates a model's ability to extract factual knowledge from text. Based on the T-REx dataset which aligns natural language with Wikidata/DBpedia knowledge base triples. Includes two evaluations: (1) Accuracy — tests knowledge extraction from clean passages, (2) Robustness — tests whether accuracy holds under noisy/perturbed input.
dataset.citation: ElSahar et al., 'T-REx: A Large Scale Alignment of Natural Language with Knowledge Base Triples', LREC 2018

project.description: Built-in benchmark: Evaluates real-world knowledge extraction using the T-REx dataset (LREC 2018). Contains two evaluations — Accuracy (clean passages) and Robustness (perturbed passages).
